name: Heart of Xoroth and Hellwrath both raise Demon's Blood's stack cap (#1297, #10363)
contract: Heart of Xoroth 704956 and Hellwrath 804014 both read 'Allows/Your Demon's Blood can now stack 5 additional times' (bindmysoul.com/conquest/talents.normalized.json, fetchedAt 2026-07-22T23:10:31.369Z; Description[enUS] of both spells names |cffffffffDemon's Blood|r explicitly, which is spell 800999 by its own Spell.dbc SpellName, not 500906 'Demonfire'). Each talent's own baked effect is the native aura 107 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER), MiscValue 31 (SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS), +5. Hellwrath's native SpellClassMask (0x20000000, 0, 0x10) already overlaps Demon's Blood 800999's family flags (0, 0, 0x10) on word 2, so its +5 reaches 800999 without any C++ correction. Heart of Xoroth carries the identical native classmask (0x20000000, 0, 0x10), which likewise overlaps 800999 on word 2, but AscensionXorothContracts.cpp previously overrode it to flag96(0, 16, 0) (word 1 = 0x10), which only matches 500906 'Demonfire' (SpellFamilyFlags word 1 = 0x10) -- a separate resource tracked by the unrelated AscensionXoroth::Gain() helper, not Demon's Blood at all. That override is corrected to flag96(0, 0, 16), matching 800999's own word 2 bit, so SpellInfo::CalcMaxAuraStacks reports 10 (base) + 5 (Heart of Xoroth) + 5 (Hellwrath) = 20 once both talents are known, matching both tooltips and #10363's reported math.
